Build passes now, exit `0`, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bump:

- `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`. It now reads the new name and falls back to the old one.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The old config loader returned `false`, the new one returns `undefined`. Unset now means off, same as before.

The 8 remaining warnings are noise. They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` and `src/utils/format.js`, which don't exist in this project. `build.js` prints those lines unconditionally, so nothing in the source can silence them. Want me to strip them from `build.js`?
